responsibility: Implements serialization of GIMPLE basic blocks to LTO streams. It emits statement tags, tuple headers, operands, locations, histograms, EH region numbers, and PHI nodes for each block, wrapping nonautomatic variable uses in MEM_REFs when needed to ease later symbol resolution, and thus provides the output-side logic that turns in-memory GIMPLE/SSA CFG blocks into the bytecode representation consumed by LTO readers.
